purpose_context: Two post-merge reviews (webview-shell-cutover, webview-render-fidelity-hardening) deferred a set of non-blocking findings to a hygiene mission so the fix missions could stay surgical: a double close-failure that freezes the recorded fatal error and never surfaces it, a superseded-late acknowledgement consumed without identity validation, dead code including the orphaned ControlIntent vocabulary family where the crest-spec and the code disagree, a gallery testing scene that serves its page without the production security policy, a page source missing from a guard scan, and documentation residue. This mission discharges them and changes no product behavior.
purpose_tldr: Sweep the deferred non-blocking findings from the two webview post-merge reviews before Phase 5 begins.
